text:
J.T. Compher has three goals and seven points in 16 games for Detroit, on a team that spent the fall without Dylan Larkin, who refused to play until he was traded. That standoff just ended with Larkin going to Montreal, which leaves the Red Wings' centre depth as the story, and Compher squarely in it.

The scoring is a little ahead of his chances: three goals on 1.7 expected, and a point rate above his talent range. The bigger issue is five on five. Detroit gets only 43% of the expected goals with him on, 7.8 points worse than without him. Some of his points have been held down by luck around him (Detroit has scored 4.4 fewer goals than expected with him on), but the chance numbers are the concern. He carries the puck in on 54% of his entries in Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking. He won the Cup with Colorado in 2022. Our range projects 24 to 40 points.
